name: Yuki no Tokeru koro ni...
source:
Your character, Dr. Hoshino, is transferred from central Japan to the New Hokkaido General Hospital, where he reunites with his underclassman, Mikage Ayumi, and academy days nemesis, Shinowara Tsukasa. As a doctor in his late 20's (he is 28 years old), he faces the trauma situations of the E.R. and treats his own clique of long-term patients.

Every successful man must have his woman behind him, and Masato's wife, Hoshino Mizuki, supports him in every way.

Life seems to be the usual...or is it? In this foreign part of Japan, covered in snow and ice, what will happen to Masato and his surroundings?

[taken from [url=http://densetsu.com/display.php?id=543&style=alphabetical]Anime Densetsu[/url]]
translation:
玩家扮演星野医生。他从日本中部调往新北海道综合医院，在那里与学妹御影步美，以及学生时代的宿敌篠原司重逢。星野真人已经28岁，作为一名年近30的医生，他既要面对急诊室中的各种创伤病例，也要治疗一群长期住院的患者。

每个成功男人背后都少不了一名女性支持，而真人的妻子星野瑞希在各个方面支撑着他。

生活似乎一如往常…真的是这样吗？在这片冰雪覆盖、对他而言十分陌生的日本土地上，真人与身边众人将遭遇什么？

[摘自[url=http://densetsu.com/display.php?id=543&style=alphabetical]Anime Densetsu[/url]]
